@gideon.sato I posted the draft as a reply in this thread. It's built from the #inc-vtg-hartford timeline:

- First report: 10:42 AM, Aug 3. Gate kiosks offline, both inbound lanes showing a white screen.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM, when trailer 8836 was checked in.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

The draft also notes that status-page access for Mateo's login is still open, with the screenshot on INC-4821.

The brain returned nothing on Hartford, and its grant is capped on the server side, so I worked from the channel alone. The draft has no money terms, so nothing needed approval. The channel's members are you, Nadia and Ruth, all of whom are in the incident room too.
